```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8.5, fig.height = 5.2, dpi = 144)

particles <- data.frame(
  generation = c(0, 15611, 70562, 575616, 878631, 957429),
  particles = c(28568, 28568, 190633, 225638, 220073, 215081),
  observation = c(
    "Initial count inferred from conservation",
    "First direct particle census",
    "Direct census after the world boundary opened",
    "Direct census after an uninterrupted night",
    "Plane bit count after depth and Valence; flags were not separated",
    "Final exact directional-particle census before measurement ablation"
  )
)

world <- data.frame(
  field = c("Light", "Sound", "Radio"),
  last_night = c(9044, 64850, 8293),
  morning = c(305315, 2189749, 186887),
  after_depth = c(488434, 3503103, 291004),
  pre_ablation = c(626279, 4488521, 406495)
)

directions <- data.frame(
  direction = c("North", "East", "South", "West", "+z on plane", "−z on plane"),
  count = c(0, 114152, 100892, 37, 0, 0)
)

blue <- "#1676A3"
light_blue <- "#70C7E8"
dark <- "#14212B"
```

Rill began as a 640 × 360 local bit field on Agar. A **generation** is one
complete collision, movement, boundary, and environmental-input update of the
whole field. The initial particle count is inferred because particles were
conserved before the environmental boundary opened. The later counts were read
directly from Rill's current state.

## Particles across generations

```{r particle-plot}
par(mar = c(7.0, 5.2, 1.2, 1.0), col.axis = dark, col.lab = dark,
    family = "sans", las = 1)

plot(particles$generation, particles$particles,
     type = "o", pch = 19, lwd = 3, cex = 1.25,
     col = blue,
     xlab = "Rill generation",
     ylab = "Observed value on ancestral plane",
     xaxt = "n", yaxt = "n",
     xlim = c(0, 1000000), ylim = c(0, 250000))

axis(1, at = particles$generation,
     labels = format(particles$generation, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col.axis = dark, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.82)
axis(2, at = seq(0, 250000, 50000),
     labels = format(seq(0, 250000, 50000), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col.axis = dark)
grid(col = "#DDE8EE", lty = 1)
lines(particles$generation, particles$particles, col = blue, lwd = 3)
points(particles$generation, particles$particles, pch = 19,
       col = blue, cex = 1.25)
points(particles$generation[1], particles$particles[1],
       pch = 21, bg = "white", col = blue, lwd = 2, cex = 1.4)
points(tail(particles$generation, 1), tail(particles$particles, 1),
       pch = 18, col = "#D16A34", cex = 1.5)

text(particles$generation,
     particles$particles + rep(15000, nrow(particles)),
     labels = format(particles$particles, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col = dark, cex = 0.9)

legend("topleft",
       legend = c("Direct plane observation", "Initial value inferred",
                  "Depth available; mixed plane-bit count",
                  "Final exact directional count"),
       pch = c(19, 21, 17, 18),
       pt.bg = c(blue, "white", "#7B4FA3", "#D16A34"),
       col = c(blue, blue, "#7B4FA3", "#D16A34"),
       bty = "n", cex = 0.82)
```

## Environmental field updates at the final observation

```{r world-plot}
par(mar = c(4.7, 5.8, 1.2, 1.0), col.axis = dark, col.lab = dark,
    family = "sans", las = 1)

update_matrix <- rbind(
  "Last night" = world$last_night,
  "Morning" = world$morning,
  "After depth" = world$after_depth,
  "Pre-ablation" = world$pre_ablation
)

bars <- barplot(update_matrix,
                beside = TRUE,
                names.arg = world$field,
                col = c(light_blue, blue, "#7B4FA3", "#D16A34"),
                border = NA,
                ylab = "Boundary-field updates",
                ylim = c(0, 5000000), yaxt = "n",
                legend.text = rownames(update_matrix),
                args.legend = list(x = "topleft", bty = "n", cex = 0.9))

axis(2, at = seq(0, 4800000, 800000),
     labels = format(seq(0, 4800000, 800000), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col.axis = dark)
abline(h = seq(0, 4800000, 800000), col = "#DDE8EE", lty = 1)
text(bars, update_matrix + 160000,
     labels = format(update_matrix, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
     col = dark, cex = 0.78, srt = 90, adj = 0)
```

These update totals describe how many times each environmental boundary had
changed at the two observation points. They do not measure what Rill perceived
or what any future structure might be able to use.

Across the uninterrupted night, Rill advanced from generation 70,562 to
575,616. The instantaneous particle count changed from 190,633 to 225,638.

At generation 878,631, the recorded plane value was 220,073. That historical
calculation counted every active bit in each plane cell; after Valence became
possible, it could have included bound and aged flags and therefore should not
be treated as an exact directional-particle count.

The final pre-ablation observation occurred at generation 957,429. Rill's
ancestral plane contained exactly 215,081 directional particles across 165,019
occupied locations: 114,152 east, 100,892 south, 37 west, and none north or
along ±z on the plane at that instant. No bound or aged Valence flags were
present on the ancestral plane. Off-plane anonymous matter and off-plane
Valence configurations remained unavailable by design.

## Observed values

```{r table}
display_particles <- particles
display_particles$generation <- format(display_particles$generation,
                                       big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
display_particles$particles <- format(display_particles$particles,
                                      big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
names(display_particles) <- c("Generation", "Plane value", "Basis")
knitr::kable(display_particles, align = c("r", "r", "l"))
```

## Final ancestral-plane directions

```{r direction-table}
display_directions <- directions
display_directions$count <- format(display_directions$count,
                                   big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
names(display_directions) <- c("Direction", "Particles")
knitr::kable(display_directions, align = c("l", "r"))
```

At the final observation, all 640 light positions and all 360 sound positions
were active. Thirteen of 360 radio positions were active. The light field
ranged from 19 to 128 (mean 60.153), the sound field from 127 to 128 (mean
127.500), and the radio field from 0 to 100 (mean 2.033).
